gloss: walk-off win; game-ending win by the home team

definitions.gloss: walk-off win; a win scored by the home team in the last at-bat
definitions.explanation: In baseball, a victory in which the home team scores the winning run in the bottom of the final (or extra) inning, ending the game instantly. サヨナラ ('goodbye') marks the abrupt end of play.

examples.japanese: ⟦{延長|えんちょう}→延長：06447_enchou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧サヨナラ{勝|が}ち⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They won on a walk-off in extra innings.

examples.japanese: {九回裏|きゅうかいうら}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ヒット→ヒット：11161_hitto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧サヨナラ{勝|が}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: They sealed a walk-off win with a hit in the bottom of the ninth.

examples.japanese: {満塁|まんるい}⟦ホームラン→ホームラン：20814_hoomuran⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{劇的|げきてき}→劇的：06830_gekiteki⟧なサヨナラ{勝|が}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}った→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧。
examples.english: They capped it off with a dramatic walk-off win on a grand slam.

notes:
A baseball term. The home team wins the instant it scores the go-ahead run in its final turn at bat, so the game ends without the opponent batting again.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- サヨナラ{勝|が}ち⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to win on a walk-off
- サヨナラ⟦ホームラン→ホームラン：20814_hoomuran⟧: walk-off home run
- サヨナラ⟦{負|ま}け→負け：02569_make⟧: a walk-off loss (from the losing side's view)

RELATED WORDS:
- サヨナラ⟦{負|ま}け→負け：02569_make⟧: walk-off loss — the same play seen from the team that gives it up
